Geographies Served Programs Women & Child Development Programs State Maharashtra States Maharashtra Since 2006, YRA has operated a counselling clinic in Bhandara in partnership with the departments of Women & Child Development and the Police Department. Many women in need have received help and assistance from this centre over the years. Restoring the dignity and self-worth of women in distress is the center's fundamental motto. Through this institution, YRA has been serving as a mediator between mothers and children in distress and police machinery. Livelihood State Maharashtra States Maharashtra Encouraging means of subsistence for the underprivileged segments of society, including women, minorities, small and marginal farmers, tribal people, Dalits, and landless labourers. YRA has concentrated on programmes that promote income generation through agro-allied, agro-based, forest-based, and other livelihoods. YRA's three pillars are designed to stabilise and enhance the poor's current portfolio of livelihoods. Reducing vulnerability and improving livelihoods by increasing available options and seizing new opportunities in the agricultural and non-agricultural sectors; Employment – developing skills for the external market; and Enterprises – fostering self-employed and entrepreneurial activity (for micro-enterprises). Milestones & Track Record YRA has implemented the Value and Quality Education Program under the HRD Ministry in Vidarbha, formed 57 village development committees with 50% women members participation in Maharashtra, and established a national-level flagship program called Child A Change Maker for holistic development of children. --> --> Leadership Team Seemantinee Khot President Anita Borkar Vice President Laxmikant Padole Secretary Mohan Dadaji Surve Treasurer John Menachery Board Member Mrunalini Milind Fadnavis Member Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAAAY0289Q Registration Number 10775/2002 CSR Form 1 CSR00002429 VO ID / Darpan ID MH/2017/0151360 --> 80G AAAAY0289QF20214 12A AAAAY0289QE20211 FCRA 83870252 About Headquarters Nagpur, Maharashtra Since 2002 Demographies Served Women Children Farmers Scheduled Castes Scheduled Tribes --> Impact YRA has directly impacted over 100,000 children in 300 schools through its Child A Change Maker program, and is currently active in 800 villages across 8 districts of Maharashtra with a team of 64 social change-makers and 540 volunteers. Vision and Mission YRA's vision is to create an empowered and capable society with all human rights, equity, peace, justice and security, without discrimination. Its mission is to facilitate social transformation through socio-economic empowerment of the rural poor by establishing their access over rights and resources.
